description: Edition- and art-revision-bound visual-register labels. Editorial review does not mean creator approval or factual verification.

objective_present.label: Present
objective_present.description: Observable action or dialogue in the scene-present frame; a character's spoken claim is not thereby proven.

personal_recollection.label: Personal memory
personal_recollection.description: Red/K/Iona lived recollection; potentially incomplete and not documentary proof by itself.

mike_memory_feed.label: Mike-to-K fragment
mike_memory_feed.description: Fragmentary, induced, one-way Mike-origin information reaching K; not K's own autobiographical memory.

stored_evidence.label: Record
stored_evidence.description: Physical or captured source with explicit provenance and bounded claim scope.

orpheus_provisional_model.label: ORPHEUS model · provisional
orpheus_provisional_model.description: ORPHEUS classification, inference, counterfactual, or reconstruction; presentation style does not verify its claim.

celestial_event.label: Celestial event
celestial_event.description: Actual celestial experience in established cosmology; do not demote it to memory or simulation by visual resemblance.

separationRules.rule: An ORPHEUS statement or reconstruction is not stored evidence unless a separate bounded source is identified.
A Mike-origin feed fragment is distinct from K's personal recollection and cannot prove K's biography by itself.
Personal recollection cannot be presented as a tape, log, or independently corroborated event.
A displayed record supports only its stated content and completeness.
A canon-confirmed celestial event stays distinct from memory and ORPHEUS reconstruction even when motifs recur.
